## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes made in this Pull Request and why they were necessary.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality or a new preset)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring or cleanup

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the coding style and conventions of this project.
- [ ] I have verified that all scripts use pure Unix LF line endings.
- [ ] I have run `./pki.sh doctor` and verified it passes.
- [ ] I have tested `./build.sh` to ensure `dist/pki-standalone.sh` compiles successfully.
- [ ] I have tested certificate generation and verification in an isolated directory.
- [ ] I have updated documentation / README.md where relevant.
